name: NVDAKitten TTS neural speech synthesizer
author: Anuj sharma
description: Offline neural speech synthesis for NVDA using Kitten TTS. Ultra-lightweight ONNX model (about 25 MB) bundled with the add-on, all dependencies included (onnxruntime-directml for CPU and GPU). 8 built-in voices (4 female, 4 male). Additional higher-quality models can be downloaded from the Kitten TTS settings panel, which also lets you choose the compute device (CPU or GPU) used for speech.
